title: Multiplexed Live-Cell Profiling with Raman probes
protocol: Reconstitute HeLa cells from ATCC under standard cell culture conditions.
Maintain HeLa cells in DMEM media supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% P/S.
Culture COS-7 cells obtained from ATCC under standard cell culture conditions.
Maintain COS-7 cells in DMEM media supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% P/S.
Obtain SKBR3 cells from ATCC for cell culture experiments.
Culture SKBR3 cells under standard cell culture conditions.
Maintain SKBR3 cells in McCoy’s 5A media supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% P/S.
Swell 4% w/v polystyrene beads in a solvent mixture of RO water and THF.
Add controlled amounts of Carbow dyes to the swollen PS bead mixture.
Agitate the dye-containing bead mixture gently at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Add 2 mL of 20 mM phosphate buffer (pH 7.3) to shrink the Rdots.
Centrifuge the mixture and resuspend in RO water using 30K MWCO filters, repeat three times.
Bioconjugate Rdots to antibodies through carboxyl-to-amine crosslinking with EDC and sulfo-NHS.
Bioconjugate Rdots to aptamers through carboxyl-to-amine crosslinking with EDC and sulfo-NHS.
Mix 200 µL 4% w/v beads vigorously with 100 µL 100 mg/mL freshly prepared EDC and 100 µL 150 mg/mL sulfo-NHS in MES buffer (25 mM, pH 6.0) at RT for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge mixture at 14500 xg twice to remove excess EDC and sulfo-NHS.
Resuspend purified beads with activated carboxyl groups in RO water using 30K MWCO filters.
Expose activated beads to 200 µL 35 mM NH2-PEG-COOH and 200 µL 320 mM NH2-PEG-OH in DPBS buffer (pH 8.1) for 3 hours at RT to yield a well-shielded PEG layer.
Remove excess PEG molecules by centrifugation three times with resuspension using 100K MWCO filters.
Activate carboxyl groups on PEGylated beads with 100 µL 100 mg/mL freshly prepared EDC and 100 µL 150 mg/mL sulfo-NHS in MES buffer (25 mM, pH 6.0) at RT for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge mixture twice to separate activated beads.
Mix activated beads with antibodies at a bead: antibody molar ratio of 1:30 and react for 3 hours in HEPES buffer (10 mM, pH 8.3) at RT.
Separate bead-Ab conjugates from free antibodies by centrifugation three rounds at 16000 rpm.
Resuspend conjugates in DPBS buffer for use.
Mix activated beads with aptamer at a bead:aptamer molar ratio of 1:100.
React the mixture for 3 hours in HEPES buffer (10 mM, pH 8.3) at room temperature.
Remove free aptamers by centrifugation through four rounds using 100K MWCO filters.
Resuspend the beads in DPBS buffer for use.
Adjust the pH of opti-MEM to 7.0, 5.5, and 4.5 by adding acid dropwise with constant stirring.
Expose Rdots to adjusted pH conditions of opti-MEM.
Measure time-dependent Raman intensity using a home-built Raman microscope.
Dissolve 4 mg/mL algae 13C amino acid mix in RO water supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% P/S.
Add vitamin, inorganic salts, and glucose according to the DMEM media formula to prepare 13C-AA DMEM.
Dissolve 17-ODYA in DMSO to create a stock solution.
Prepare a working stock solution of 4 mM by complexing 17-ODYA with BSA at a ratio of 1:6.
Synthesize 13C-EdU according to the previously reported method.
Dissolve AltQ2 in DMSO to obtain a stock solution of 10 mM for use.
Incubate SKBR3 cells with 1 nM endocytosis beads for 6 hours.
Mix cells with 10 nM Rdots for surface protein labeling.
Dissociate cells using trypsin-EDTA when they reach 75% confluence.
Harvest and wash cells twice with ice-cold DPBS.
Resuspend cells in DPBS buffer containing 5 mM MgCl2, 1 mg/mL yeast tRNA, and 1% BSA to achieve a concentration of 10^7 cells per mL.
Incubate aptamer-conjugated Rdots at 90°C for 4 minutes on a heat block, then cool slowly to room temperature.
Stain cells with seven-colored Rdot conjugates at a concentration of 10 nM for 30 minutes on ice.
Wash cells three times with DBS buffer containing 5 mM MgCl2 and 1% BSA.
Attach cells onto poly-L-lysine coated coverslips.
Mount coverslips onto the microscope for Raman measurement.
Seed SKBR3 cells onto 18mm round quartz coverslips.
Maintain seeded cells in culture environment for 48 hours to reach 90% confluence.
Replace the culture medium with <sup>13</sup>C-AA DMEM containing 200 µM 17-ODYA and 50 nM <sup>13</sup>C-EdU.
Subject cells to drug treatment according to Supplementary Table 3.
Wash cells gently with DPBS buffer three times.
Incubate cells with three-colored endocytic Rdots at 1 nM in serum-free DMEM for 6 hours.
Stain cell surface markers with seven-colored Rdots at a concentration of 10 nM on ice for 1 hour.
Wash cells extensively with DPBS buffer containing 5 mM MgCl<sub>2</sub> and 1% BSA.
Rinse cells with DPBS buffer containing 5 mM MgCl<sub>2</sub> and 40 µM AltQ2.
Mount cells onto the microscope for Raman measurement.
Perform spectral unmixing through the Least Square Method (LSM) for the amide region and cell silent region.
